purpose: 4article actual-public A21 diagnosis; no source changes and no quality-pass exemptions

articles.scope: Actual accepted public MP4 plus original native precheck reproduced from exact original cache; no actual new MP4 was generated by the failed native job.
limits: Only the accepted prior MP4 is a real video input; the failed current run stopped before1080 rendering.
Cache-only reconstruction matches actual original native precheck values, but is not passed delivery or a substitute for a new formal native video/checks.
MP4 AAC is postfiltered; measurements here are independent actual-public evidence, not assumed identical to raw original producer PCM.
In-memory removal/boost variations are diagnostic only and do not alter source files, cache, accepted MP4, or official programs.
